posture: The pool trusts a Groth16 proof over seven public inputs, an owner who adds Merkle roots, and keys from an unrecorded setup. The transfer circuit never binds the Merkle leaf to the spent note or its position, so any prover with a public path withdraws arbitrary amounts with unlimited fresh nullifiers. Public-input order, field-range checks and the 64-bit split of In.Value are consistent between circuit and contract. The single most important action is to bind the leaf to H(Secret, In.Value, In.Owner) and order the path by Index bits, then regenerate keys in a multi-party ceremony at a patched gnark version.
out_of_scope: Solidity beyond the ZK integration (Pool deposit flow absent; solidity-auditor not installed)
SigCircuit integration: no consumer in the repository

records.title: Merkle leaf is not bound to the spent note
records.description: Any prover opens any public leaf under a known root, because Path[0] is never derived from Secret, In.Value or In.Owner. In.Value is therefore free, so the prover also picks the payout.
records.proof: Take a root R with knownRoots[R] = true and its leftmost public path (L, S1, S2, S3), so MiMC(MiMC(MiMC(L,S1),S2),S3) = R. Witness: Path = [L,S1,S2,S3], Secret = 7, Index = 1, nf = MiMC(7,1), In.Value = Out.Value = 2^64-1, honest divHint (q = 1), honest splitHint limbs (2^32-1, 2^32-1), Fees = (0,1), In.Owner = Out.Owner = 0, Recipient = attacker, Extra = [0,0]. Every constraint at transfer.go:47-92 holds with honest hints; withdraw(proof, R, nf, attacker, 0, 1, 2^64-1, 0) pays 2^64-1 wei (T-INVALID-ASSIGNMENT, then T-FOUNDRY-VERIFIER).
records.impact: Any prover with no deposit withdraws up to 2^64-1 wei per proof and, with fresh nullifiers, drains the whole Pool.

gates.executes: No constraint ties Path[0] to Secret, In or Index (transfer.go:47-56); amounts are only related to the free In.Value (transfer.go:64-80).
gates.reachable: Tree data under an owner-added root is public; honest hints solve the witness, no hint override needed.
gates.unprivileged: Any prover and any caller of Pool.withdraw.
gates.impact: Soundness: theft of all pooled ETH.

fix.summary: Compute the leaf in-circuit from the note and its secret, and assert it equals Path[0].

options.label: bind the leaf to the note
options.diff:
+	h.Reset()
+	h.Write(c.Secret, c.In.Value, c.In.Owner)
+	api.AssertIsEqual(c.Path[0], h.Sum())

refuter.reasoning: No constraint in TransferCircuit.Define (circuit/transfer.go:42-94) ties Path[0] to Secret, In.Value or In.Owner: cur := c.Path[0] (transfer.go:50) is a raw witness checked only against Root (transfer.go:56). With In.Value = Out.Value = V < 2^64, q = 1 satisfies transfer.go:64, the limb split (66-72) and change = 0 (80) hold, Index = 1 voids the owner gate (82-83), and fresh Secret gives a fresh nf (47-48). Pool.withdraw checks only the root (Pool.sol:39) and the nullifier (Pool.sol:40) before paying value (Pool.sol:51). Caveat: Verifier.sol is a placeholder; the attack assumes the generated verifier is deployed.

records.title: Nullifier is derived from free Secret and Index
records.description: Any prover mints a fresh nullifier for the same leaf by changing Secret or Index, because neither is the leaf's preimage or its tree position.
records.proof: Fix one path (L, S1, S2, S3) under a known root R and the witness of the leaf finding. Proof k uses Index = k (or Secret = k): nf_k = MiMC(Secret, k) are pairwise distinct and all other constraints are unchanged, since the path hashing at transfer.go:50-56 ignores Index. Each withdraw(proof_k, R, nf_k, ...) passes !nullifiers[nf_k] (Pool.sol:40). Index varies the nullifier even after the leaf is bound to H(Secret, In.Value, In.Owner). Side effect: the always-left path makes every leaf except position 0 unprovable for honest users.
records.impact: Any note holder spends one note an unlimited number of times and drains other depositors' funds.

gates.executes: nf = MiMC(Secret, Index) (transfer.go:47-48); Index appears only there and in IsZero (transfer.go:82); the path never uses it.
gates.reachable: Any Index value solves; honest hints suffice.

fix.summary: Make Index the leaf position by using its bits to order each Merkle level, and derive the nullifier from the bound leaf.

options.label: order the path by Index bits
options.diff:
-	cur := c.Path[0]
-	for i := 1; i < len(c.Path); i++ {
-		h.Reset()
-		h.Write(cur, c.Path[i])
-		cur = h.Sum()
-	}
+	idx := api.ToBinary(c.Index, Depth)
+	cur := c.Path[0]
+	for i := 1; i < len(c.Path); i++ {
+		l := api.Select(idx[i-1], c.Path[i], cur)
+		r := api.Select(idx[i-1], cur, c.Path[i])
+		h.Reset()
+		h.Write(l, r)
+		cur = h.Sum()
+	}

refuter.reasoning: The nullifier is constrained only at circuit/transfer.go:47-48 (MiMC(Secret, Index) == nf). The Merkle check (transfer.go:50-56) always hashes cur on the left and uses neither Secret nor Index, and no other constraint (58-92) involves them except IsZero(Index) at 82-83, which any nonzero Index satisfies. Pool.withdraw (Pool.sol:39-51) tracks only nullifiers, not leaves, so each fresh nf pays again. Even with a bound leaf, Index stays free in the nullifier hash.

records.title: divHint quotient relation is checked only over the field
records.description: The circuit asserts q*Out.Value == In.Value mod r and discards the remainder, so any prover passes a non-divisible pair while the honest hint fails it.
records.proof: In.Value = 7, Out.Value = 2. Honest divHint returns (3, 1); 3*2 != 7, so the honest prover fails. Override divHint to q = 7*2^-1 mod r; AssertIsEqual at transfer.go:64 holds and all other constraints hold (T-HINT-OVERRIDE).
records.impact: Honest users cannot prove a withdrawal whose amount does not divide their input value; the intended integer rule binds nothing for a malicious prover.

gates.executes: Only transfer.go:64 constrains q; res[1] is discarded at transfer.go:63; q has no range check.
gates.impact: Completeness for honest users; the soundness side is bounded by Out.Value <= In.Value (transfer.go:79-80).

fix.summary: Constrain q*Out + rem == In with q and rem range-checked to 64 bits and rem < Out, or drop the relation if exact division is not intended.

records.title: Owner equality is gated by a prover-chosen Index
records.description: Any prover sets the private Index to a nonzero value, which zeroes flag and removes the In.Owner == Out.Owner check, so ownerKey proves nothing.
records.proof: Witness of the leaf finding with In.Owner = 1, Out.Owner = 2, Index = 1: flag = IsZero(1) = 0 and 0*(1-2) = 0 holds. The same witness with Index = 0 fails (T-INVALID-ASSIGNMENT).
records.impact: Out.Owner (public ownerKey) is unconstrained; any consumer that treats it as the note owner is misled. Pool ignores it today.

gates.executes: transfer.go:82-83 is the only constraint on Out.Owner besides a discarded ToBinary (transfer.go:77).
gates.reachable: Index is a free secret witness.
gates.impact: Owner continuity is not enforced; promoted on convergence of five agents (judging.md §5), no on-chain victim shown.

fix.summary: Assert api.AssertIsEqual(c.In.Owner, c.Out.Owner) unconditionally, or gate it on a bound value.

records.title: gnark v0.14.0 matches three std soundness advisories
records.description: go.mod pins gnark v0.14.0, below the fixes for GHSA-3mvx-pp85-pm65, GHSA-7fx8-hmgc-82jp and GHSA-fwf3-jmp7-gmrj; SigCircuit uses emulated arithmetic named in GHSA-3mvx.
records.proof: go.mod:8 requires github.com/consensys/gnark v0.14.0; fixed versions are v0.16.2, v0.16.4 and v0.16.0 (stack.json). SigCircuit calls emulated.NewField and f.Mul (sig.go:34-38). TransferCircuit uses no affected component; SigCircuit has no consumer.
records.impact: If SigCircuit is deployed, emulated-arithmetic soundness bugs at this version apply; keys made at this version must be regenerated after an upgrade.

gates.reachable: Only SigCircuit reaches an affected component.
gates.impact: Low: no consumer of SigCircuit in the repo; two advisories name components not imported.

fix.summary: Upgrade gnark to v0.16.4 or later, recompile circuits, and regenerate proving and verifying keys and the Solidity verifier.

records.title: Groth16 keys come from a single-party setup
records.description: cmd/setup runs groth16.Setup in one process and exports its VK, so whoever ran it holds toxic waste and forges proofs for any public inputs.
records.proof: groth16.Setup(ccs) at main.go:21 samples the whole trapdoor; vk.ExportSolidity at main.go:31 is the only key path; no mpcsetup import exists.
records.impact: If production keys came from this command, the setup operator can drain the Pool with forged proofs.
blockers: Which VK is deployed and how it was produced is not in the repository.
contracts/Verifier.sol is a placeholder, not generator output.
records.validation_plan: Obtain the deployed verifier's VK and the ceremony transcript; confirm it came from a multi-party ceremony (gnark mpcsetup) rather than cmd/setup.

records.title: Nonzero check reads one limb of an unreduced emulated product
records.description: SigCircuit asserts sq.Limbs[0] != 0 on a non-strictly reduced f.Mul result, so a prover may pick a representation that makes Amount = 0 mod n pass.
records.proof: Amount.Limbs = n (secp256k1 order); mul hint quotient n-1, remainder n; n*n = (n-1)*n + n and n < 2^256; sq.Limbs[0] = 0xBFD25E8CD0364141 != 0.
records.impact: A zero amount passes the nonzero check, and an honest nonzero square with a zero low limb fails. No consumer of SigCircuit exists.
blockers: Whether gnark v0.14.0 emulated Mul bounds its remainder below the modulus (std not in module cache).
SigCircuit has no verifier or caller in the repository.
records.validation_plan: Run a T-HINT-OVERRIDE test against gnark v0.14.0 with Amount = n and the overridden mul hint; check whether ccs.Solve succeeds.

fix.summary: Use f.IsZero(sq) asserted to 0 (or f.ReduceStrict before reading limbs) and f.AssertIsInRange(&c.Amount).
